LoRABlendOne.description: Merge up to eight compatible Standard LoRAs into one verified safetensors file. Auto uses a weighted delta merge; Advanced exposes TIES, DARE, DELLA, rank/compression, dtype, device, compatibility, and reproducibility controls.

lora_1.name: LoRA 1
lora_1.tooltip: First LoRA file. Common Standard LoRA factor formats supported by ComfyUI are recognized.

weight_1.name: Weight 1 (%)
weight_1.tooltip: Weight in percent. Normalize mode converts the selected positive weights into ratios summing to 100%.

lora_2.name: LoRA 2
lora_2.tooltip: Second LoRA file. Use (none) to process a single LoRA for rank or dtype conversion.

weight_2.name: Weight 2 (%)
weight_2.tooltip: Weight in percent. Example: 30 and 70 produces a 30:70 weighted delta merge.

output_rank.name: Output Rank
output_rank.tooltip: Auto follows Compression (or Krea2 defaults). A selected rank caps every output layer, including energy and none compression.

filename_prefix.name: Filename Prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Output filename prefix under ComfyUI/output. A unique counter is appended.

merge_method.name: Merge Method
merge_method.tooltip: Auto uses Weighted. Krea2 Gate-Aware uses two LoRAs and applies direct percentages with gate conflict handling; TIES, DARE, and DELLA remain available.

weight_mode.name: Weight Mode
weight_mode.tooltip: Standard methods: normalize or direct. Krea2 Gate-Aware always uses percentages directly (50 = 0.5).

compression_mode.name: Compression
compression_mode.tooltip: Compression for standard methods. Weighted none is exact with Output Rank Auto; a lower selected rank compresses. Krea2 uses its dedicated controls.

custom_rank.name: Custom Rank
custom_rank.tooltip: Used when Output Rank is Custom.

energy_target.name: Energy Target
energy_target.tooltip: Numerical delta energy target. It is not an image-quality percentage.

auto_rank_cap.name: Auto Rank Cap
auto_rank_cap.tooltip: Safety cap for randomized SVD in TIES/DARE/DELLA Auto rank.

density.name: Density
density.tooltip: TIES magnitude keep fraction, DARE keep probability, or DELLA center keep probability.

sign_consensus.name: Sign Consensus
sign_consensus.tooltip: Auto enables it for TIES/DELLA and disables it for DARE.

della_half_width.name: DELLA Half Width
della_half_width.tooltip: Half-width of DELLA's magnitude-ranked keep-probability range.

output_dtype.name: Storage Dtype
output_dtype.tooltip: Compute is FP32; this selects the saved tensor dtype.

device.name: Compute Device
device.tooltip: Auto selects CUDA only when estimated working memory fits comfortably.

fallback_policy.name: OOM Fallback
fallback_policy.tooltip: auto_cpu retries an OOM layer on CPU without changing merge settings.

unmatched_policy.name: Unmatched Layers
unmatched_policy.tooltip: How to handle a layer present in only some selected LoRAs.

compatibility_mode.name: Compatibility
compatibility_mode.tooltip: Safe mode blocks obvious cross-architecture disjoint merges.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Local deterministic seed for stochastic merge/refactor operations.

gate_conflict_threshold.name: Gate Conflict Threshold
gate_conflict_threshold.tooltip: Diagnostic cosine threshold only; Auto does not alter gate strengths.

hash_inputs.name: Hash Inputs
hash_inputs.tooltip: Store SHA-256 hashes of input LoRAs in the recipe.

write_report.name: Write Report
write_report.tooltip: Write a detailed JSON sidecar report next to the merged safetensors file.

krea2_gate_strength.name: Krea2 Gate Strength
krea2_gate_strength.tooltip: Krea2 only: multiply matched gate layers after source strengths.

krea2_opposite_strategy.name: Krea2 Opposing Gates
krea2_opposite_strategy.tooltip: Krea2 only: keep the stronger opposing gate or zero it.

krea2_opposite_threshold.name: Krea2 Opposite Threshold
krea2_opposite_threshold.tooltip: Krea2 only: gate cosine below the negative threshold counts as a conflict.

krea2_gate_rank.name: Krea2 Gate Rank
krea2_gate_rank.tooltip: Krea2 only: rank for compressed gates.

krea2_balance_mode.name: Krea2 Balance
krea2_balance_mode.tooltip: Krea2 only: optionally equalize matched layer norms.

krea2_gate_compression.name: Krea2 Gate Compression
krea2_gate_compression.tooltip: Krea2 only: compress attention gates or all gates when they do not conflict.

krea2_normal_compression.name: Krea2 Normal Compression
krea2_normal_compression.tooltip: Krea2 only: optionally compress ordinary matched layers to the larger input rank.

0.tooltip: Saved path, resolved method, layer/rank summary, gate conflict count, and warning count.

base_model.name: Base Model
base_model.tooltip: Original full model used as the starting point before fine-tuning or merging. Select model weights, not a LoRA. The extracted difference is Modified Model minus Base Model. Both files must have compatible MOSS-Image architecture and shapes; matching shapes alone does not prove this is the correct training base.

modified_model.name: Modified Model
modified_model.tooltip: Full model after fine-tuning or merging, based on the selected Base Model. This is not a LoRA file. Swapping the two models reverses the difference. Identical weights produce no output. Only single, non-quantized native MOSS-Image Safetensors are currently supported.

mode.name: Extraction Mode
mode.tooltip: Fixed Rank: use the specified integer rank for each matrix, capped by its dimensions. Auto Rank: choose a rank per matrix for Target Energy, limited by Maximum Rank. Full Delta: store the complete difference without SVD compression; large ComfyUI extension file, not a standard LoRA.

rank.name: Rank
rank.tooltip: Used only in Fixed Rank mode; default 32. Rank Preset offers 16, 32, 64, 128 and 256. Any integer from 1 to 4096 is valid, including 17 or 24; it is not restricted to multiples of 8 or powers of two. Common examples: 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256. Lower ranks usually save space but lose more difference information. No rank guarantees faithful recovery. Each layer is also limited by its matrix dimensions.

energy.name: Target Energy
energy.tooltip: Used only in Auto Rank mode. 0.99 means retaining 99% of squared weight-difference energy before storage conversion, roughly 10% relative Frobenius error; it is not 99% image similarity. Maximum Rank can prevent reaching the target. BF16/FP16 rounding can leave individual saved layers slightly below it.

dtype.name: Storage Type
dtype.tooltip: Precision of saved factors/differences; subtraction and factor calculations use FP32. BF16 has a wider value range than FP16. FP32 uses more disk space. Non-finite values or storage overflow stop the save; precision is never changed automatically.

filename_prefix.name: Filename Prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Output name under ComfyUI's configured output directory. Subfolders are allowed; a unique numbered suffix is added without overwriting existing files. The result is not automatically installed in the LoRA folder. Put it in a configured LoRA folder to select it in a loader.

scan.name: Inspection Depth
scan.tooltip: Header checks supported model keys and shapes without comparing weight values. Full Scan reads all weights, checks finite values, and counts changed/nonmatrix parameters; it takes longer. Inspection does not extract or save a LoRA.

max_rank.name: Maximum Rank
max_rank.tooltip: Per-matrix rank ceiling for Auto Rank, not a target rank for every layer. If too small, the energy target is missed and reported. Larger ranks increase time and output size; a high-retention LoRA can exceed the full model in size. Only Auto Rank uses this setting.

device.name: Compute Device
device.tooltip: SVD computation device. cpu avoids CUDA allocation. cuda requests GPU computation. auto chooses CUDA only when its memory estimate fits; otherwise CPU. CUDA out-of-memory retries on CPU with the same settings. Model files are read on CPU.

svd.name: SVD Method
svd.tooltip: auto uses exact SVD for small matrices and randomized approximation for larger ones. exact is slower but uses the full spectrum for rank selection. randomized uses a seeded approximation and may retain less energy at the same rank. Fixed/Auto Rank only; Full Delta does not use SVD.

non_lora.name: Non-LoRA Changes
non_lora.tooltip: What to do with changed normalization/bias or other nonmatrix parameters: Stop rejects them. Store Diff preserves them as .diff in a ComfyUI hybrid file, which current Blend One Sources cannot blend. Exclude With Report drops them and marks the output PARTIAL; the complete model change is not reproduced. Full Delta stores all selected changes.

key_filter.name: Target Key Pattern
key_filter.tooltip: Wildcard filter on normalized parameter keys, e.g. diffusion_model.layers.*.proj.*.weight. * selects all targets. Excluded changed parameters are reported and count as reconstruction error; filtering can produce a partial model difference.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Reproducibility seed for randomized SVD, not image generation. Keep this value and Seed Behavior fixed to repeat an approximation. Exact SVD and Full Delta do not use it for decomposition.

hash_inputs.name: Hash Inputs
hash_inputs.tooltip: Calculate SHA256 of both complete input files and record it for identification and reproducibility. It adds disk reads and startup time, and does not change the extracted weights.

write_report.name: Write Report
write_report.tooltip: Write a sidecar .safetensors.report.json with settings, selected ranks, warnings, exclusions, and measured reconstruction errors. A report write failure warns while preserving a successfully saved main file.

purpose.name: Output Purpose
purpose.tooltip: ComfyUI Loading preserves nonmatrix changes as Store Diff. Blend One Source requires standard LoRA; partial extraction needs explicit consent.

allow_partial.name: Allow Partial Extraction
allow_partial.tooltip: For Blend One Source only: explicitly allow excluding changed nonmatrix parameters. The output cannot reproduce all model changes.

LoRABlendModelInspect.description: Compare the original Base Model with its Modified Model. Extraction saves Modified minus Base. MOSS-Image only; model files, not LoRAs.

0.name: info

plan_action.name: Plan Action
plan_action.tooltip: Connected plans start in Review Only: display your current settings and recommendations without saving. Extract and Save uses the editable settings on this node. Recommendations are copied only by the Apply Recommendations button. Unconnected manual extraction works as before.
